status: single established-profile diagnostic; not a startup benchmark

separateNonGuiShellProbeMilliseconds.setup: Three /bin/zsh -i -l -c runs per command with VSCODE_RESOLVING_ENVIRONMENT=1 and output suppressed; not paired with the GUI trace or original Code-OSS.

method: An environment-gated main-process log records wall-clock shell start and completion; renderer and extension-host marks use absolute epoch milliseconds. The trace tool correlates them after an isolated warm-up and normal quit. The control extension's activation is not the extension-editable-file benchmark endpoint. One launch cannot estimate p95 or recoverable time.
limits: The separate shell-only probe suggests user login-shell initialization dominates this local interval; it does not isolate a product regression or justify skipping shell initialization. The final shell environment is required at utilityProcess.fork. The 119 ms wrapper wait is an observed gate, not a safe speed saving. This trace does not compare against original Code-OSS, and no public startup gain is claimed.
